introHtml: Polyester resistance bands offer a durable, non-latex alternative for corporate fitness programs and promotional giveaways. Unlike rubber bands, polyester webbing resists fraying and maintains tension over time, making them ideal for repeated use in gyms or office wellness kits. Customize with your logo using screen printing or heat transfer for a vibrant, long-lasting imprint. Perfect for safety managers promoting physical activity or HR directors distributing branded fitness accessories at health fairs.
